title: Oil Painting Sequence
content: Here's a step-by-step sequence from a plein-air oil study I painted a few years ago. All through the two hour process, I was eager to paint in the tiny flecks of foamy bubbles and the highlights along the waterline, but I held off on those until the end. (Link to video on Facebook)The painting appeared in my bookColor and Light: A Guide for the Realist Painteravailable on Amazonorsigned on my web store.Previously:Color in Mountain Streams
